name: Kingboard Holdings Limited
summary: Kingboard Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells laminates and printed circuit boards. The company also offers chemical products, including coke, methanol, benzene, tar, acetic acid, propylene, methyl tert-butyl ether, liquefied petroleum gas, phenol, acetone, bisphenol A, caustic soda, polyvinyl chloride, hydrochloric acid, liquefied chlorine, chlorinated wax, sodium sulfate, formalin, hydrogen peroxide, and tetrabromobisphenol. In addition, it is involved in the manufacture and distribution of magnetic and glass fabric products; property investment and development activities; rental of commercial properties; sales of residential units; and refining and distribution of chemicals. The company sells its products in the People's Republic of China, Thailand, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Europe, and the United States. The company was formerly known as Kingboard Chemical Holdings Limited and changed its name to Kingboard Holdings Limited in July 2018. Kingboard Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong.
